Heavy Rains and Monsoon Floods in Southeast Asia

1.why: A wider channel area increases the total volume of water flowing through per second.

wrong.c: Rainfall adds water but doesn't change channel area.

2.why: Q is volumetric flow rate measured in cubic metres per second.

3.why: Clearing river channels helps water flow faster and reduces overflow.

wrong.d: Covering soil with concrete increases runoff.

_quiz_pool.question: What does Q stand for in Q = A × v?
_quiz_pool.explanation: Q represents the volume of water passing per second.

_quiz_pool.question: What is the unit of flow velocity v?
If cross-sectional area A doubles while speed stays the same, flow Q…
_quiz_pool.explanation: Q grows directly with area A.

_quiz_pool.question: What causes urban flash floods during heavy rain?
_quiz_pool.explanation: Concrete stops water from soaking into the ground.

_quiz_pool.question: Which agency monitors Indonesian weather and rain?
What is the unit of cross-sectional area A?
_quiz_pool.explanation: Area is measured in square metres (m²).

_quiz_pool.question: Heavy monsoon rains in Southeast Asia are driven by…
What does clearing river rubbish help do?
_quiz_pool.explanation: Clearing blockages helps water flow smoothly.

_quiz_pool.question: Why do rivers rise quickly after cloudbursts?

story.title: Rushing waters after heavy rains
story.lead: Weather agencies issued warnings as heavy monsoon downpours struck the region [1]. Fast-flowing water filled rivers and drainage canals [2].
story.image_caption: Satellite view of heavy rainfall systems over Southeast Asia
stat.1.label: water flow rate in the river channel
stat.2.label: flow speed of water moving downstream
stat.3.label: cross-sectional area of the channel
story.body_1: During heavy rainstorms, huge amounts of water run off streets and roofs into rivers [1]. When the water volume increases too fast, rivers overflow their banks. Scientists monitor river discharge to predict floods early [3].
story.body_2: Clearing river channels and protecting soil help manage flood risks [2]. Understanding how water flows helps cities build better drainage systems [3].
timeline.1.text: Heavy rain pours over the city and fills drainage channels.
timeline.2.text: Rushing water surges through narrow river sections.
timeline.3.text: Water slowly drains out toward the sea.
physics.title: Area, speed and flow rate
physics.body_1: When water flows through a river or pipe, how much water passes each second depends on two main things: how wide the channel is and how fast the water moves.
physics.body_2: The volumetric flow rate, Q, is found by multiplying the cross-sectional area of the channel by the flow velocity. Larger areas and higher speeds move more water.
physics.assumptions: We assume steady, uniform water flow and a rectangular channel cross-section.

lab.title: Drainage test: clear vs blocked
lab.step_1: Set up two sloped trays, one clear and one with obstacles.
lab.step_2: Pour a measured cup of water down both trays.
lab.step_3: Time how fast the water reaches the bottom.
lab.question: Which tray drained faster? Use flow concepts to explain why.
